The '''1995–96 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 60th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 26 August 1995 and ended on 29 May 1996. [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] won their second consecutive and 18th Greek title.
